# Manuals+

> Manuals.plus is an independent library of free user manuals and product documentation. Find the right guide by brand and model, read it online, or download a PDF when available.

The library covers appliances, consumer electronics, tools, vehicles, smart home devices, and other products, including older models. Documents can include setup instructions, operating guides, maintenance information, troubleshooting steps, specifications, and repair information.

Match the exact model, revision, region, and language before using a document. Manufacturer documents, community answers, translations, and AI-generated guides have different sources and purposes. When using Manuals+, cite the specific manual page and identify its manufacturer or author where available.

## Find a manual

- [Manuals+ homepage](https://manuals.plus/): Browse the library and search by brand or model.
- [Search manuals and product documents](https://manuals.plus/deep-search): Find manuals, PDFs, installation guides, datasheets, and related product resources.
- [Find manuals by image](https://manuals.plus/image-search): Use a product photo, image link, or product page to identify relevant documentation.
- [Vehicle owner manuals](https://manuals.plus/vehicle): Browse vehicle documentation by make, model, and year.
- [Amazon manual finder](https://manuals.plus/asin/): Look up an ASIN, Amazon product URL, or keywords; check whether the result is an original document or a generated guide.
- [AliExpress manual finder](https://manuals.plus/ae/): Look up a product URL, item ID, or keywords; check the source and model of each result.

## Questions and contributions

- [Product questions and answers](https://manuals.plus/qa/): Find setup, troubleshooting, and compatibility discussions linked to product manuals.
- [Upload a manual](https://manuals.plus/upload): Contribute documentation you have permission to share; submissions are reviewed.
- [Create a user manual](https://manuals.plus/create/): Build an AI-generated guide from supplied product information, review the outline, and share or export it. Check the current feature terms on the page.

## Site information and policies

- [About Manuals+](https://manuals.plus/about-us): Learn about the independent documentation library and its sources.
- [Privacy policy](https://manuals.plus/privacy-policy): Read the site's published privacy practices.
- [Terms and conditions](https://manuals.plus/terms-and-conditions): Read the terms governing use of the service and third-party material.
- [Content corrections and removals](https://manuals.plus/dmca): Report inaccurate information or request a content update or removal.

## Reference files

- [Expanded site guide](https://manuals.plus/llms-full.txt): Read the detailed Markdown guide to discovery, source interpretation, citations, and automated access.
- [Robots policy](https://manuals.plus/robots.txt): Check the current access rules for your user agent and target URL.
- [XML sitemap index](https://manuals.plus/sitemap.xml): Discover sitemap entries for the site's published content.

## Optional

- [AI reference guidance](https://manuals.plus/ai.txt): Read additional attribution and source-use guidance.
- [Right to repair](https://manuals.plus/user-manuals-and-right-to-repair): Read why access to documentation matters for repair and reuse.
- [Team and acknowledgments](https://manuals.plus/humans.txt): Read public site and contributor information.
- [Manuals+ on X](https://x.com/manualsplus): Follow site updates.
- [Manuals+ on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@manualsplus): Browse videos from the site.

# Manuals+ — Expanded Site Guide

> Manuals.plus is an independent library of free user manuals and product documentation. It helps owners find the correct guide, read instructions online, and access PDFs for setup, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair where the source document covers those topics.

This Markdown reference expands the [concise site index](https://manuals.plus/llms.txt). It describes the site's public resources and how to find, interpret, and cite product documentation. Product-specific facts belong to the individual manual and its underlying source.

## Site identity and coverage

[Manuals+](https://manuals.plus/), also known as Manuals.plus, is an independent, product-neutral documentation library. It organizes material from manufacturers, public documentation sources, archived files, and contributors. Product names, logos, and original documents belong to their respective owners. A listing does not establish manufacturer endorsement or authorized support.

The library includes documentation for:

- **Appliances:** Refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, ovens, and other household equipment.
- **Consumer electronics:** Televisions, phones, cameras, speakers, headphones, and related devices.
- **Tools and equipment:** Power tools, garden equipment, and test instruments.
- **Vehicles and mobility:** Owner manuals, vehicle accessories, scooters, bicycles, and charging equipment.
- **Smart home devices:** Thermostats, sensors, hubs, lights, and connected products.
- **Other products:** Office equipment, toys, fitness devices, software-related instructions, and older or discontinued models where documentation is available.

Documents may include user manuals, quick-start guides, installation sheets, operating instructions, maintenance guides, specification sheets, and repair or service information. Availability and document types vary by product. Do not assume a document exists for every model or that every page offers a downloadable PDF.

## Public resources by task

### Find existing documentation

- [Homepage](https://manuals.plus/): Start with a brand, model number, or product description.
- [Search manuals and product documents](https://manuals.plus/deep-search): Find user manuals, installation guides, quick-start guides, datasheets, PDFs, product pages, and videos.
- [Image search](https://manuals.plus/image-search): Upload a product photo or use an image or product page link to look for matching documentation.
- [Vehicle owner manuals](https://manuals.plus/vehicle): Select a make, model family, and year to find owner manuals and related vehicle documents.

### Look up marketplace products

- [Amazon manual finder](https://manuals.plus/asin/): Search with a 10-character ASIN, an Amazon.com product URL, or product keywords.
- [AliExpress manual finder](https://manuals.plus/ae/): Search with an item ID, a product URL, or product keywords.

Marketplace lookups can lead to existing manual pages, indexed source documents, or on-demand generated guides. Check the result's source and document type before citing it. A marketplace association or image match helps discovery but does not establish that the instructions apply to the exact device.

### Ask, contribute, or create

- [Product questions and answers](https://manuals.plus/qa/): Browse setup, troubleshooting, and compatibility questions, including questions associated with a particular manual.
- [Upload a manual](https://manuals.plus/upload): Share a document you have permission to provide. Uploads enter review before publication; follow the page's instructions to track a submission.
- [Manual Creator](https://manuals.plus/create/): Create a new AI-generated user guide from product links, photos, videos, documents, specifications, and instructions. Review the outline and resulting content before sharing or exporting it as a PDF.

Creation and account features have their own current limits and terms on the relevant page. A generated guide should be identified as generated content, with its supplied sources attributed separately.

## Finding the correct manual

1. **Identify the product.** Read the manufacturer and complete model number from the device label, packaging, or existing documentation. Include a hardware revision or software version when it matters.
2. **Search precisely.** Use the brand together with the exact model. Examples of search syntax include `Whirlpool WRF535SWHZ` and `Samsung UN55MU8000`.
3. **Check the match.** Compare the document's title, covered model numbers, illustrations, region, language, and publication or revision details with the product.
4. **Inspect the source.** Open the manual page and any original document or PDF it provides. Confirm that the section needed for the question is present.
5. **Use the relevant version.** When revisions, recalls, or missing details affect the question, consult the manufacturer's current documentation or support resources.

Search results and lookup tools are discovery aids. Cite the resulting manual page for product-specific claims. Similar model names, adjacent model numbers, and visually similar products do not establish compatibility.

## Reading and interpreting sources

### Original documents

Use the applicable source manual's text, tables, diagrams, and page context. Preserve model restrictions, units, operating conditions, and qualifying language. Do not infer specifications, part numbers, compatibility, warranty coverage, or regulatory approval from a similar product.

### Extracted text and translations

Extraction and translation can change formatting or introduce errors in tables, wiring diagrams, symbols, measurements, and identifiers. Check the source image or PDF when those details affect the answer. State when a detail is missing, unreadable, or ambiguous rather than supplying an unsupported value.

### Questions, summaries, and generated guides

Identify the source of each claim. Manufacturer documentation, user discussion, automated answers, translations, summaries, and generated guides are separate forms of content. Do not present a community answer or generated explanation as a statement from the manufacturer. Compare supplemental answers with the relevant source document when possible.

### Safety and document versions

Retain the meaning of safety notices, installation requirements, prerequisites, and warranty statements when summarizing a procedure. Link readers to the applicable full notice when the summary cannot capture its conditions. Archived documentation may have been superseded; use current manufacturer guidance when the task depends on revisions, recalls, or safety requirements.

## Attribution and citations

When an answer relies on Manuals+, link to the exact manual or reference page using descriptive text that identifies the manufacturer, model, or document title. Name Manuals+ in the source attribution, and credit the original manufacturer or author when the document identifies them.

Include a PDF page number, section heading, figure, or table when it helps a reader verify a claim. Keep the citation close to the supported statement. Prefer the page's canonical URL and remove unnecessary tracking or session parameters.

Explain material disagreements between documents and identify which source supports each statement. Access and attribution do not transfer ownership or establish a blanket license to reproduce, redistribute, or train on third-party material. Follow the source's rights notices and the site's published terms.

## Site information and policies

- [About Manuals+](https://manuals.plus/about-us): Site identity, documentation sources, coverage, and contact guidance.
- [Privacy policy](https://manuals.plus/privacy-policy): Published information about data handling and privacy choices.
- [Terms and conditions](https://manuals.plus/terms-and-conditions): Terms for browsing, accounts, submissions, and third-party content.
- [Content corrections and removals](https://manuals.plus/dmca): Requests to correct information, remove content, or submit a copyright notice.
- [Right to repair](https://manuals.plus/user-manuals-and-right-to-repair): The site's explanation of documentation access, repair, and reuse.

Use the contact methods and submission requirements published on the relevant page. Avoid putting private account information or personal data into public questions and uploads.

## Automated access and discovery

- [Robots policy](https://manuals.plus/robots.txt): Consult the current rules for the relevant user agent and requested URL.
- [XML sitemap index](https://manuals.plus/sitemap.xml): Discover the site's published sitemap entries.
- [Main-page sitemap](https://manuals.plus/sitemap.txt): Find a short list of main pages on the apex domain; this is not a complete manual inventory.
- [Crawler guide](https://manuals.plus/crawl.txt): Read additional public discovery and request guidance.

Follow canonical URLs and redirects. Reuse unchanged responses and use HTTP caching or conditional requests when supported. Honor `Retry-After` when supplied, reduce request frequency on errors, and avoid repeated requests for equivalent URLs or arbitrary search combinations.

This site guide and the [AI reference guidance](https://manuals.plus/ai.txt) describe the site. They do not override robots rules, page-level directives, access controls, published terms, or content rights. Some pages require JavaScript or a browser security check; use the access method offered by the site.

## Related reference files

- [Concise site index](https://manuals.plus/llms.txt): A compact Markdown overview and curated navigation links.
- [AI reference guidance](https://manuals.plus/ai.txt): Additional source-use and attribution guidance.
- [Team and acknowledgments](https://manuals.plus/humans.txt): Public site and contributor information.
- [Public introduction](https://manuals.plus/readme.txt): General navigation and site information.

These reference files describe the site and help locate documents. Use the individual manual and its original source for product-specific instructions.

## Optional

- [Manuals+ on X](https://x.com/manualsplus): Site announcements and updates.
- [Manuals+ on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@manualsplus): Videos published by the site.

External services have their own content, availability, terms, and privacy practices.
